title: apex-ayl.108.1 GREEN ratchet (msgw-caching-receipts F2 — the dominant claude-side cache invalidator) — extend verbatim replay of older signed thinking: strip_thinking_blocks (ST/conversation/messages.rs:266; xli S-031 = codex-rs first-party parity, CONSCIOUS DEVIATION per the apex-ayl.108 decision, ledger:2814) retains an assistant turn's signed thinking exactly ONE request, then drops it, so every post-strip turn re-reads only up to the last pre-reasoning prefix (receipts: corpus claude turns serve only 43.2% of input as cache reads despite 73-98% per-turn steady state). Three headless claude-sonnet-5 turns, each thinking-forcing (modular exponentiation; models/default_reasoning_effort=max per the O7 M-1 lesson — adaptive on by default for sonnet-5). Fixed layout: t1 main = [u1]; t2 main = [u1, a1, u2]; t3 main = [u1, a1, u2, a2, u3] — a1 is assistant-at-messages[1] in BOTH the t2 and t3 main requests. The title side call (max_tokens=100, first-hand Run A) is excluded from the main-call pins by the max_tokens=128000 filter (every main call is 128000, first-hand). CONTROL pins (class model): in the t2 MAIN request (nth=1 of the role-filtered set, count-bounded 2), messages[1].content[0].type == 'thinking' AND signature ne '' — proves t1 reasoned AND the one-request retention replays it as latest (a miss = t1 did not reason = VACUOUS, never a false red; an absent path FAILs, run.py:2192-2195). RED PINS (the .108.1 verdict): in the t3 MAIN request (nth=0 of the role-filtered set), messages[1].content[0].type == 'thinking' AND signature ne '' — t1's thinking, now at an OLDER (non-latest) position, SURVIVES VERBATIM (text + signature byte-identical to the t2 capture — the mint, gate step M1). Pre-cut FAILs: a1's thinking is stripped by the t3 request (content[0] = 'text'). GREEN when the extended replay (thinking_replay row key, default on) lands. The API permits replaying earlier thinking verbatim (text+signature pairs are immutable) — the GREEN state is API-legal. SIDE EFFECT: this GREEN also clears the .112 RED ratchet mgw-cache-stripread (MGW-STRIPREAD-01's red pin is a strict subset of red1 — same where/nth/path/eq) — zero re-pin owed to .112. The resp200x3 pins (max_tokens=128000 filter, count-bounded 3) prove the API ACCEPTS the replayed shape (HTTP 200 on all three main calls) — the GREEN-case evidence for the SDD 3.1 state assumption. Recon pins are non-scoring: the mint signature source + the per-call cache_read_input_tokens witness feed (SDD 4.3 targets).
